<polyline points="540,610 800,610" fill="none" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="673" y="588" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#326991">溶媒前緣</text>
<polyline points="540,1040 800,1040" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="673" y="1020" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">起始線</text>
<polyline points="655,1120 800,1120" fill="none" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<text x="678" y="1166" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#326991">槽內液面</text>
<rect x="875" y="470" width="930" height="345" rx="18" fill="#dcecdc" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="899" y="513" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#356844">先核四項輸入</text>
<text x="899" y="563.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">1 板的塗層是真正保留相；材料／黏合劑／指示劑不同。</text>
<text x="899" y="597.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">2 點樣線高於液面，檢品與標準體積按方法受控。</text>
<text x="899" y="631.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">3 展開前點樣已乾；普通槽蒸氣與板活性按方法控制。</text>
<text x="899" y="665.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">4 前緣到適當位置即取出標記，不等乾了才找線。</text>
<rect x="875" y="865" width="930" height="345" rx="18" fill="#fff1c8" stroke="#9e771c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="899" y="908" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#9e771c">這張圖交給M03什麼</text>
<text x="899" y="958.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">可見／可定位的斑點中心與已標前緣。</text>
<text x="899" y="992.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L02量共同起點的a、b；L03同板參考比較。</text>
<text x="899" y="1026.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L09用參考道、點樣量與記錄區分過載等原因。</text>
<text x="899" y="1060.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">藍線＝液體前緣／毛細前進；彩色圓＝示意斑點，非實測。</text>
<rect x="645" y="1340" width="610" height="145" rx="18" fill="#dcecdc" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="669" y="1383" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#356844">M02｜先標前緣，再乾燥</text>
<text x="669" y="1433.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">依目的選一條或相容偵測；不一律三種依次做。</text>
<rect x="50" y="1565" width="570" height="350" rx="18" fill="#e8e1f2" stroke="#685185" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="1608" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#685185">UV／光學定位</text>
<text x="74" y="1658.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">254 nm：F254背景可被吸光物質遮弱為暗點。</text>
<text x="74" y="1691" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">365 nm：適合物質／衍生物發螢光。</text>
<text x="74" y="1723.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L10：讀位置與暗／亮；定量另需校正。</text>
<polyline points="950,1485 950,1525 335,1525 335,1565" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="335.0,1565.0 328.8,1553.6 341.2,1553.6" fill="#61717a"/>
<polyline points="335,1915 335,1950 950,1950" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<rect x="665" y="1565" width="570" height="350" rx="18" fill="#e8e1f2" stroke="#685185" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="689" y="1608" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#685185">化學定位／呈色</text>
<text x="689" y="1658.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">按F03–10選試劑、加熱與條件。</text>
<text x="689" y="1691" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Ninhydrin→可反應胺；固醇藍點／螢光配對分清。</text>
<text x="689" y="1723.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L11–12：若需回收，先選較少破壞方法。</text>
<polyline points="950,1485 950,1525 950,1525 950,1565" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="950.0,1565.0 943.8,1553.6 956.2,1553.6" fill="#61717a"/>
<polyline points="950,1915 950,1950 950,1950" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<rect x="1280" y="1565" width="570" height="350" rx="18" fill="#dceaf7" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="1304" y="1608" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#326991">放射偵測配置</text>
<text x="1304" y="1658.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">已有合適分離程序，接Radio-scanner或分段計數。</text>
<text x="1304" y="1691" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">L15：讀各形式活性，目的形式／總活性。</text>
<text x="1304" y="1723.66" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">不是用普通UV亮度計放射純度。</text>
<polyline points="950,1485 950,1525 1565,1525 1565,1565" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="1565.0,1565.0 1558.8,1553.6 1571.2,1553.6" fill="#61717a"/>
<polyline points="1565,1915 1565,1950 950,1950" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polyline points="950,1950 950,1995" fill="none" stroke="#61717a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<polygon points="950.0,1995.0 943.8,1983.6 956.2,1983.6" fill="#61717a"/>
<rect x="450" y="1995" width="1000" height="205" rx="18" fill="#dceaf7" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="474" y="2038" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#326991">M03→M04｜量、基準與判準</text>
<text x="474" y="2088.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">位置：a/b。量：C×V與反應比較，或光學校正。</text>
<text x="474" y="2122.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">放射：目的形式活性／總活性。</text>
<text x="474" y="2156.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">先檢方法是否可比，再交結論；觀察到拖尾不等於唯一原因。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2270" width="875" height="192" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="2313" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">液面淹點樣線</text>
<text x="74" y="2363.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">檢品可溶進槽 → M02降低液面、重點重跑。</text>
<rect x="975" y="2270" width="875" height="192" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="999" y="2313" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">前緣遺失／越出板</text>
<text x="999" y="2363.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">不能猜b → M02重展開，M03再讀距離。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2490" width="875" height="192" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="2533" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">拖尾、點太大</text>
<text x="74" y="2583.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">查過載、濕點或表面作用 → M02控制量與乾燥。</text>
<rect x="975" y="2490" width="875" height="192" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="999" y="2533" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">同Rf卻證據不足</text>
<text x="999" y="2583.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">可能共同移行 → M04限縮；必要時M02換選擇性。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2710" width="875" height="192" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="2753" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">不同體積只比濃度</text>
<text x="74" y="2803.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">量基準錯 → M03補C×V；同物質或按方法校正。</text>
<rect x="975" y="2710" width="875" height="192" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="999" y="2753" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">顯色後才想到回收</text>
<text x="999" y="2803.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">目的／配置錯 → M01先定回收，M02換適當定位。</text>
<text x="50" y="3096" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">縮寫：Rf＝比移值；UV＝紫外光；HPTLC＝高效能薄層層析；2D＝二維；RCP＝放射化學純度；F254＝254 nm螢光指示劑。</text>
<text x="50" y="3132" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">灰箭頭＝分析程序／資訊；藍箭頭＝溶劑毛細前進。偵測是用途支路，不是硬體或試劑全串聯。</text>
<text x="50" y="3168" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">來源：CH19 PDF；建構講義 v3.0。M＝大循環站；L＝理解模組；P＝方法／配置。圖5板面距離同刻度，其餘示意不按比例。</text>

<title id="tlc3_g5_title">薄層層析 TLC｜公式與誤差判讀總表</title><desc id="tlc3_g5_desc">薄層層析教學向量圖，v3.0。四站角色固定：先定問題、準備與測量、讀訊號、核對結論。灰線表示分析資訊；圖4藍線為溶劑前進與前緣，灰線為分析程序；斑點與UV子圖另附圖例。圖5板上距離採同刻度，其餘示意不按比例。紅虛線表示條件不符的分析者回查。示意不按比例。</desc>

<text x="50" y="120" font-size="38" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">薄層層析 TLC｜公式與誤差判讀總表</text>
<text x="50" y="164" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">先問位置、質量、比較線、光學訊號或放射活性；每個量用自己的定義與基準。</text>

<text x="1451" y="288" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">判讀、限制與品質</text>

<text x="78" y="414" font-size="28" font-weight="600" fill="#24343f">C01／L02｜同一條起始線，才有同一把尺</text>

<text x="964" y="563.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">EX01：前緣8 cm；檢品2、4 cm；參考4 cm。</text>
<text x="964" y="597.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同起點：Rf檢品0.25、0.50；參考0.50。</text>
<text x="964" y="631.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03資料 → L02距離比 → M04比位置。</text>
<text x="964" y="665.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">相符位置不證唯一身分，亦不量出含量（L03、14）。</text>

<text x="964" y="893" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#9e771c">若題給板底座標，先兩邊扣原點</text>
<text x="964" y="943.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">原點1.5；斑點5.5；前緣9.5 cm。</text>
<text x="964" y="977.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">a=5.5−1.5=4，b=9.5−1.5=8。</text>
<text x="964" y="1011.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">Rf=4/8=0.50；不能直接5.5/9.5。</text>
<text x="78" y="1132" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">示意距離按同一刻度呈現；斑點大小不代表質量。</text>
<rect x="50" y="1230" width="875" height="400" rx="18" fill="#dcecdc" stroke="#356844" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="1273" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#356844">C02｜100Rf表示法</text>
<text x="74" y="1323.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">問真Rf：Rf=(100Rf)/100。</text>
<text x="74" y="1357.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">54 → 0.54；18 → 0.18。</text>
<text x="74" y="1391.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03表值→L08換尺度→M04讀位置。</text>
<text x="74" y="1425.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">相同0.54可共同移行；不是含量相同。</text>
<rect x="975" y="1230" width="875" height="400" rx="18" fill="#dceaf7" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="999" y="1273" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#326991">C03｜% w/v變點樣質量</text>
<text x="999" y="1323.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">m=C×V；4%=4 g/100 mL=40 mg/mL。</text>
<text x="999" y="1357.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">10 μL=0.010 mL → m=0.40 mg=400 μg。</text>
<text x="999" y="1391.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03濃度與V→L13→M04量基準。</text>
<text x="999" y="1425.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">μL不能當mL；濃度不是板上總量。</text>
<rect x="50" y="1660" width="875" height="400" rx="18" fill="#dceaf7" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="1703" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#326991">C04｜名目比較百分比</text>
<text x="74" y="1753.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">P=(C標×V標)/(C檢×V檢)×100%。</text>
<text x="74" y="1787.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同V：0.04/4×100%=1%。</text>
<text x="74" y="1821.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">比較液V兩倍：1%×2=2%。</text>
<text x="74" y="1855.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03 C、V→L13→M04比較線。</text>
<text x="74" y="1889.66" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同反應或依方法；不是通用LOD。</text>
<rect x="975" y="1660" width="875" height="400" rx="18" fill="#dceaf7" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="999" y="1703" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#326991">C05｜反求比較液濃度</text>
<text x="999" y="1753.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同V：C標=[P/(100%)]×C檢。</text>
<text x="999" y="1787.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">P=1.5%，C檢=4% w/v：</text>
<text x="999" y="1821.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">C標=0.015×4%=0.06% w/v。</text>
<text x="999" y="1855.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回代0.06/4×100%=1.5%。</text>
<text x="999" y="1889.66" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">舊比較線算術不代表現行藥典規格。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2090" width="875" height="400" rx="18" fill="#dceaf7" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="2133" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#326991">C06｜光學校正求量</text>
<text x="74" y="2183.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">自編局部線性：S=s×m+S0。</text>
<text x="74" y="2217.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">m=(S−S0)/s；S=9、s=2、S0=1：</text>
<text x="74" y="2251.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">m=4 μg；回代2×4+1=9。</text>
<text x="74" y="2285.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03訊號／標準→L14→M04求量。</text>
<text x="74" y="2319.66" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">限同物質及校正有效範圍，不能用Rf。</text>
<rect x="975" y="2090" width="875" height="400" rx="18" fill="#dceaf7" stroke="#326991" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="999" y="2133" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#326991">C07｜放射化學純度</text>
<text x="999" y="2183.34" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">RCP=目的形式活性/總活性×100%。</text>
<text x="999" y="2217.42" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">92 Bq＋8 Bq → 92/100×100%=92%。</text>
<text x="999" y="2251.5" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">M03各形式活性→L15→M04純度。</text>
<text x="999" y="2285.58" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">同核種、同基準；不是不同核種比例。</text>
<text x="999" y="2319.66" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">放射活性不等於普通顏色深淺。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2580" width="875" height="195" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="2623" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">錯起點／單位</text>
<text x="74" y="2673.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M03重讀兩段距離；前緣真的遺失則M02重展開。</text>
<rect x="975" y="2580" width="875" height="195" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="999" y="2623" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">兩點Rf相同／未見點</text>
<text x="999" y="2673.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">先查共同移行與偵測能力；不直接判同藥或無藥。</text>
<rect x="50" y="2805" width="875" height="195" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="74" y="2848" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">顏色深淺跨物質比較</text>
<text x="74" y="2898.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M03找同物質標準與有效反應校正；查重疊及背景。</text>
<rect x="975" y="2805" width="875" height="195" rx="18" fill="#f5dfe2" stroke="#b72d4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="999" y="2848" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#b72d4a">條件改了還沿用Rf</text>
<text x="999" y="2898.34" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#24343f">回M02固定配方、板與操作，再在M03取得新讀數。</text>
<text x="50" y="3070" font-size="21" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">符號：C＝質量濃度；V＝點樣體積；m＝質量；P＝比較百分比；S＝光學訊號；RCP＝放射化學純度。</text>
<text x="50" y="3146" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">縮寫：Rf＝比移值；UV＝紫外光；HPTLC＝高效能薄層層析；2D＝二維；RCP＝放射化學純度；F254＝254 nm螢光指示劑。</text>
<text x="50" y="3182" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">Rf位置、C×V質量、光學訊號與放射活性分開；先選量，再選式。C06與數值驗算為自編。</text>
<text x="50" y="3218" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#61717a">來源：CH19 PDF；建構講義 v3.0。M＝大循環站；L＝理解模組；P＝方法／配置。圖5板面距離同刻度，其餘示意不按比例。</text>
</svg>
